pages.text: Used to implant organs into the body or extract them.$(br2)$(bold)Transplant:$(reset)$(li)3 solidified essence + 20,000 life energy, 80 ticks (4 seconds)$(li)the target slot must be empty$(li)writes the starting rejection: native organs start at 0, higher grades start higher$(br2)$(bold)Extract:$(reset)1 solidified essence + 5,000 life energy, you take damage to that body part and rejection resets to zero.$(br2)$(bold)Note:$(reset) surgery only runs while the $(reset)GUI is open$(reset) - closing it or dying mid-procedure interrupts the work.

pages.title: Implanting & Rejection
pages.text: Rejection is an organ's $(reset)compatibility score$(reset) with your body: the slot type (organ/limb) sets the rules for rejection and side effects, while the grade sets its starting value and growth - higher grades raise both the starting value and the growth rate.$(br2)$(bold)Managing rejection:$(reset) see the $(l:akaishi:life_potions)Life Potions$(/l) entry for the rejection serum; if an organ cannot be maintained, extract it at the Surgery Chamber.$(br2)Pair the Surgery Chamber with the $(l:akaishi:life_vaults)Vaults$(/l)' Organ Vault within 3 blocks for linked item access.
Organ source: Organ Construction. Rejection control: Life Potions.
